shortDescription: Create, update, or delete L4 load balancer instances via Servers.com Public API

options.name: cluster_id
options.description: Unique identifier of a dedicated Load Balancer cluster. If omitted, a shared cluster is used.

options.name: delete_external_ips
options.description: List of external IP addresses to delete (update only).

options.name: endpoint
options.description: Endpoint to use to connect to API. Do not change until specifically asked to do otherwise. If not set, the value of the C(SERVERSCOM_API_URL) environment variable is used.

options.name: id
options.description: Unique identifier of the load balancer. I(state)=Q(present), either I(id) or I(name). For state 'absent', provide exactly one of I(id) or I(name).

options.name: labels
options.description: Dictionary of labels to attach to the load balancer.

options.name: location_id
options.description: Location ID where the load balancer will be created. (Required for creation)

options.name: name
options.description: Name for the load balancer. For creation (I(state)=Q(present) without an I(id)), required. For update, provide either I(id) or I(name) (but not both).

options.name: new_external_ips_count
options.description: Number of new external IP addresses (update only).

options.name: shared_cluster
options.description: If true, the load balancer will move to a shared cluster (update only).

options.name: state
options.description: Define the desired state of the load balancer instance.

options.name: store_logs_region_id
options.description: Cloud region ID for log storage.

options.name: token
options.description: Token to use. You can create token for your account in https://portal.servers.com in Profile -> Public API section. If not set, the value of the C(SERVERSCOM_API_TOKEN) or C(SC_TOKEN) environment variable is used (C(SERVERSCOM_API_TOKEN) takes precedence). Value is not logged.

options.name: update_interval
options.description: Interval in seconds between consecutive status checks during state transitions.

options.name: upstream_zones
options.description: List of upstream zone objects grouping upstream servers. Required for creation.

options.name: vhost_zones
options.description: List of vhost zone objects defining forwarding rules. Required for creation.

options.name: wait
options.description:
Maximum time in seconds to wait for the load balancer instance to reach
the desired state after an action (e.g. deletion)."
